disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraud during the examination or in applying for, renewing, or securing any license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committed fraud during the administration of the examination for a license or certificate to practice or to have committed fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, renewing, or securing any license or certificate to practice or certificate to recommend issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting one's name or license to be used by a person not actually directing treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting one's name or one's license or certificate to practice to be used by a person, group, or corporation when the individual concerned is not actually directing the treatment given

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain minimal standards in selection or administration of drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain minimal standards applicable to the selection or administration of drugs, or failure to employ acceptable scientific methods in the selection of drugs or other modalities for treatment of disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, giving, prescribing, or administering drugs for other than legitimate therapeutic purposes or drug law violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: selling, giving away, personally furnishing, prescribing, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully betraying a professional confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully betraying a professional confidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statement in solicitation, advertising, or in relation to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statement in the solicitation of or advertising for patients; in relation to the practice of medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, podiatric medicine and surgery, or a limited branch of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departure from or failure to conform to minimal standards of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A departure from, or the failure to conform to, minimal standards of care of similar practitioners under the same or similar circumstances, whether or not actual injury to a patient is established

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing that an incurable disease or condition can be permanently cured for personal gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing, with the purpose of obtaining compensation or other advantage as personal gain or for any other person, that an incurable disease or injury, or other incurable condition, can be permanently cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining money or anything of value by fraudulent misrepresentations in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The obtaining of, or attempting to obtain, money or anything of value by fraudulent misrepresentations in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty plea or judicial finding of guilt for a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an act that constitutes a felony in this state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of an act that constitutes a felony in this state, regardless of the jurisdiction in which the act was committed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty plea or finding for a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty plea or finding for a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of conditions placed on a license by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the conditions of limitation placed by the board upon a license or certificate to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay license renewal fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay license renewal fees specified in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in division of fees for referral of patients or receiving value for specific patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in the division of fees for referral of patients, or the receiving of a thing of value in return for a specific referral of a patient to utilize a particular service or business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of a code of ethics of relevant national professional organizations including APMA
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of any provision of a code of ethics of the American medical association, the American osteopathic association, the American podiatric medical association, or any other national professional organizations that the board specifies by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice according to acceptable standards due to mental or physical illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care by reason of mental illness or physical illness, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration that adversely affects cognitive, motor, or perceptive skills.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of this chapter or any rule promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate, any provisions of this chapter or any rule promulgated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse action against the individual's license by another licensing agency for any reason other than nonpayment of fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any of the following actions taken by an agency responsible for authorizing, certifying, or regulating an individual to practice a health care occupation or provide health care services in this state or another jurisdiction, for any reason other than the nonpayment of fees: the limitation, revocation, or suspension of an individual's license to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, restriction, or termination of clinical privileges by DOD/VA or DEA certificate revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation, suspension, restriction, reduction, or termination of clinical privileges by the United States department of defense or department of veterans affairs or the termination or suspension of a certificate of registration to prescribe drugs by the drug enforcement administration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Termination or suspension from participation in Medicare or Medicaid programs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Termination or suspension from participation in the medicare or medicaid programs by the department of health and human services or other responsible agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment of ability to practice due to substance use disorder or excessive use of drugs or alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment of ability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care because of substance use disorder or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that may impair ability to practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Second or subsequent violation of patient referral fee provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A second or subsequent violation of section 4731.66 or 4731.69 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Waiving or advertising waiver of deductibles or copayments as patient enticement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Waiving the payment of all or any part of a deductible or copayment that a patient, pursuant to a health insurance or health care policy, contract, or plan that covers the individual's services, otherwise would be required to pay if the waiver is used as an enticement to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to use universal blood and body fluid precautions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to use universal blood and body fluid precautions established by rules adopted under section 4731.051 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide notice to patients of lack of malpractice insurance coverage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide notice to, and receive acknowledgment of the notice from, a patient when required by section 4731.143 of the Revised Code prior to providing nonemergency professional services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a podiatrist to enter into or fulfill standard care arrangement with collaborating nurse practitioners/CNMs/CNS
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a physician or podiatrist to enter into a standard care arrangement with a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner with whom the physician or podiatrist is in collaboration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate in a board investigation including failure to comply with subpoenas
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate in an investigation conducted by the board under division (F) of this section, including failure to comply with a subpoena or order issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting suicide as defined by statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting suicide, as defined in section 3795.01 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with standards and procedures for operation of a pain management clinic
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the standards and procedures established in rules under section 4731.054 of the Revised Code for the operation of or the provision of care at a pain management clinic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with drug database requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 4729.79 or 4731.055 of the Revised Code, unless the state board of pharmacy no longer maintains a drug database

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with requirements before issuing opioid prescriptions for minors
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements in section 3719.061 of the Revised Code before issuing for a minor a prescription for an opioid analgesic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with requirements when recommending treatment with medical marijuana
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 4731.30 of the Revised Code or rules adopted under section 4731.301 of the Revised Code when recommending treatment with medical marijuana

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with requirements when certifying a decedent's cause of death
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 3705.16 of the Revised Code when certifying a decedent's cause of death and completing and signing the medical certificate of death.

definition_quote.value: The practice of podiatric medicine and surgery consists of the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot; and superficial lesions of the hand other than those associated with trauma.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine and surgery consists of the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot; and superficial lesions of the hand other than those associated with trauma.

methods_authorized.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine and surgery consists of the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists are permitted the use of such preparations, medicines, and drugs as may be necessary for the treatment of such ailments.
drug_authority.quote: Podiatrists are permitted the use of such preparations, medicines, and drugs as may be necessary for the treatment of such ailments.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: General anaesthetics may be used under this section only in colleges of podiatric medicine and surgery in good standing with the state medical board and in hospitals approved by the joint commission or the American osteopathic association.

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: the patient shall be concurrently referred to a doctor of medicine or a doctor of osteopathic medicine and surgery for the treatment of the systemic disease itself

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: A podiatrist may treat the local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear in the hand and foot

value: American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery

telehealth_authorized.quote: A physician may provide telehealth services in accordance with sections 4743.09 of the Revised Code.

vaccination_authority.quote: A podiatrist may administer to individuals who are seven years of age or older vaccinations against both of the following: (A) Influenza; (B) COVID-19.

advanced_practice_nurse_collaboration_au.quote: A physician or podiatrist shall enter into a standard care arrangement with each clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner with whom the physician or podiatrist is in collaboration.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: The state medical board shall establish a confidential, nondisciplinary program for the evaluation and treatment of practitioners and applicants who are, or may be, impaired
